common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background panorama for a full 2D side-view fantasy bird racing game. Create one wide landscape image, approximately 2048 x 1024, with detailed hand-painted Japanese fantasy game environment art, delicate brush texture, layered atmospheric depth, readable silhouettes, harmonious muted colors. Camera: level side-on from outside the course looking across the distant landscape; no overhead view, no strong vanishing-point track. The upper 55 percent contains sky and the venue landmarks, the bottom 45 percent is quiet open terrain with very little contrast so racing sprites and the independently drawn track can overlay it. Horizontally repeatable composition: left and right edges have matching horizon heights, sky and ground colors; keep landmarks away from the edges, no framing or vignette. Soft diffuse daylight. Background only: no birds, riders, people, race lanes, fences, posts, gates, goal lines, track markings, HUD, letters, logos, watermarks or readable text.
